note: Policy catalog. The gate enforces max_bytes and, for metadata_only, the JSON format; allows/forbids are instructions to the private model that no code checks. Ordered narrowest first; 'width' is the order used for the injection rule (a pour after ○ content may not use a wider policy than the session's previous pour without approval). max_bytes is checked by the gate on the UTF-8 payload.

policies.allows: file paths and column names (no digits), types, units, number of categorical levels, year ranges, row count rounded to the nearest 10
policies.forbids: any value copied from a row, min/max, exact counts below 10, names, IDs, dates, amounts
policies.format: JSON only, checked by the gate: {"files":[{"path":"data/visits.csv","rows_about":60,"columns":[{"name":"arm","type":"categorical","levels":3},{"name":"visit_date","type":"date","years":[2019,2023]},{"name":"cost","type":"number","unit":"currency"}]}]}. path: letters, _ . / - only, at most 48; name: letters and _ only, at most 32; type: string|integer|number|boolean|date|categorical; unit: count|currency|percent|ratio|years|months|days|hours|minutes|seconds|kg|g|m|cm|celsius; levels 0-1000; years [from,to] within 1900-2100; rows_about a multiple of 10; no other fields

policies.allows: a metadata_only description plus the analysis question; asks the answerer for code to run sealed
counts, means, SDs, model coefficients, test statistics, each computed over at least k rows
policies.forbids: any statistic over fewer than k rows; min/max/outliers; two aggregates whose difference isolates fewer than k rows

policies.allows: an abstracted question in prose: hypothetical or structural form, generalized quantities (ratios, ranges)
policies.forbids: names, IDs, emails, codenames, award numbers, exact dates, exact dollar amounts, quoted text from private documents
